packageRules.description: Server middleware: skip hotfix (patch) releases, they are picked up together with the next minor or major bump
Server middleware: one PR that Renovate keeps refreshed with the newest versions, merge it while preparing the next minor release
kubeadm upgrades a cluster by one minor version at a time, so each Kubernetes minor gets its own PR
prBodyNotes: kubeadm upgrades a cluster by one minor version at a time: ship at most one Kubernetes minor bump per OpenCRVS release, and check that `calico_version` supports it.

packageRules.description: pgBackRest must match the version installed in the Postgres pod by opencrvs-core, so it gets its own PR
prBodyNotes: The backup server and the Postgres pod must run the same pgBackRest version: bump `postgres.pgbackrest_version` in opencrvs-core `charts/dependencies/values.yaml` to the same version in the same release.

packageRules.description: The runner controller and scale set charts must stay on the same version and ship CRDs, so ARC gets its own PR
prBodyNotes: `arc_scale_set_chart_version` installs both `gha-runner-scale-set-controller` and `gha-runner-scale-set`, which are published with the same versions. Helm does not upgrade CRDs, provisioning applies them with `helm show crds`. Read the release notes for breaking changes (0.x minor versions may have them) and provision a sandbox environment before the release.

packageRules.description: Helm 4 is not yet compatible with the kubernetes.core.helm module, see group_vars/all.yml
